steps.name: Chun
steps.text: You almost hit a bookshelf.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: I am no swordswoman and I have no interest in admiring Chi Xiao. But it would be a shame if your sword ruins the collection of the Sky Mirror Pavilion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But you are not confident about taking the token from me.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: Is that so?
The Elf now truly waves her jade scepter and twig for the first time.
Withered vines rush out from the ground, forming massive hands.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Dammit, she's a nightmare to deal with! Is the Sui Regulator's Supervisor decided through combat?!

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: How does the book go anyway... ah, I remember—and it's autumn, this is perfect...

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: 'Metal's nature is change.'

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: For a thief, you're pretty well-learned.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: I wouldn't be surprised if I know Yin-Yang and the Five Elements better than someone who's forgotten her roots.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Zuo Le! Ch'en Hui-chieh! Your turn!
Zuo Le charges towards Chun, intent on disrupting her ability to respond.
Meanwhile, Ch'en Hui-chieh pulls back, waiting for an opportunity to strike.
In between them, Mo Yi unleashes razor-sharp autumn winds, tangling with the vine hands.
The Supervisor of the Sui Regulator continues to stand where she is, utterly impassive, as though she is watching a farce that she is becoming increasingly bored with.
Ch'en Hui-chieh continues to back off, until her back is almost touching the closed door.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Damn... can't hold on much longer!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Ch'en!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Chi Xiao...
Riding on the autumn wind, the sword aura sweeps away all the vines. The Elf looks surprised for a brief moment.
Then, dried leaves sharp as razors fly out from the vines towards the trio.
Mo Yi urgently casts a defensive spell, but the leaves cut their clothes and bags open...
The token that has slumbered since it was retrieved from the Garden of Grotesqueries falls on the ground.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: This is the token from the Garden of Grotesqueries?

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: It is a geist.
It is, indeed, a geist.
The weiqi player had taken Sui's wildest imagination from the Garden of Grotesqueries and hollowed out the interior, leaving only the gleaming exterior...
The memories of his siblings were then injected to create this object.
Made of a glass-like substance, the tiny geist lies immobile on the ground for a while... then, it seems to grow ethereal.
It awakens.
It does not seem to feel pain. Or perhaps, the pain was overcome by the urge to return to this familiar place.
She begins to stumble towards the door.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: That is...

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: Impossible!
All it takes is a single thought from the Elf, and the churning vines could shatter the object to smithereens. But Chun cannot bring herself to do it.
Because she truly does see a familiar figure in it.
The object touches the door, and it is as though a dream that has slumbered for a hundred years is suddenly awakened by an intruder.
The falling dust forms thousands of golden threads drifting in the air in the setting sun. The sliver of life force ripples.
All breaths are held as they see the ethereal figure that drifts between light and shadow in the falling dust.
It is blurry, indistinct, the only clear feature its grey robe, like paper that has grown yellow from the passage of time, but still smelling faintly of old books and dried ink...
The door opens slowly.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: How do you get in, if you give me the key?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Why should the master of the house need a key?
The shadow bends slightly, as though trying to pick up the cracked scroll on the desk.
Or perhaps it is walking towards the window to open the sash closed for so long, to see if the osmanthus that was young back then has bloomed this year.
But her movement ultimately freezes between the done and the undone, a faint wisp of melancholy suspended in the sunset.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Put this scroll on the shelf by the wall. Leave that document on the desk; it's not yet finished.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: A painting from Dusk? I should find a good place to hang it.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: Why do I have to do these chores for you?!

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Oh? But Nian said her Candleholder even helps her put together mahjong games.
Desk, chair and scrolls... every object in the room breathes with the shadow. They are her old friends, and she is the reason they never left.
A gust of wind blows through the room. The geist falls asleep and the shadow dissipates like a drop of ink that falls into water, leaving behind only that which is real, the shadows of dust.
And the sun, shining into an empty room.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: It's...

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: Her...

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: No, she was a little taller, her hair a little blacker... she was thin, but not like that...
She cannot, would not accept, yet there is a single question that she could never answer.
Who else could it be?

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Who else could it be?
The stunned Elf does not even notice the appearance of the proxy, one who is very much flesh and blood.
She continues to stand at the same spot, staring in the direction where the shadow disappeared.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I came as you asked.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: But it seems you no longer have anything to say to me.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: It's her... it's really her...

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: I never thought... I didn't think there was any trace of her existence left...

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: There is no doubt about it. It's a sliver of her life force, which those young people retrieved from the Sui's Remnant Consciousness.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: As for traces of her existence... they are in the books of the Sky Mirror Pavilion, in countless scholars across the land of Yan.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Now, do you still believe that everything we siblings have done since Jie's disappearance is futile, Candleholder Chun?

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: If... if you can still find a trace of her somewhere...

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: Tell her...
The long-lived Candleholder chokes on her own words. She gazes wordlessly at the study, the interior of which has not changed for a century.
Having taken it all in, she turns around and slowly walks towards the exit, fighting the urge to look back at every step.
Leaving this place she knows best, yet brings her the most despair.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: ...I did not know that Wang's obsession was this paranoid, yet so deep.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I saw you at the city gates...

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: And we meet again.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: You are... Jun?

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Thank you for protecting her token.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Lady Jun... no, Master Jun.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: I heard you were a close friend of the grandmaster's, and I have long heard your name spoken of with reference... it is an honor to meet you.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Don't try to curry favor with me. I'm not even sure if I had been born at the time of the old carpenter's death.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I'm glad to see that someone still remembers his views after a thousand years have passed.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: But did you do what you did at Mangshan Town out of a desire for peace, or out of your own bitter cynicism? Do you really need me to tell you?

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: The old Tianshi gave you an opportunity to make up for your transgressions. Have you done so?
The proxy does not raise her voice, and there is no anger in it, but her voice naturally begets respect.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: I've long heard of the second Sui sister's unapproachable nature. Today, I got to witness it.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: There is always hope for those who learn from their mistakes.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Zuo Le.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Academician Jun...

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Words cannot express my gratitude for you bringing back this sliver of Jie's life force from the Garden of Grotesqueries.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Our family will remember the favor, and repay it when the time is right.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm simply doing my duty as a Candleholder. The Supervisor lost her composure, but the candle of the Sui Regulator remains lit.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: She was trapped between the greater good and personal desire, and was eventually crushed by her own obsessions... you must not repeat her mistakes, when the time comes for you to take on great responsibility.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Now, though, it is more useful for you to go outside than to stay here and look at relics of the past.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Take this girl too, and put her somewhere safe downstairs. It is late autumn, and the floor is cold.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I trust you will handle the matter of the writing knife properly, Academician Jun.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: One more request, if I may.
Jun turns around and picks up the geist from the ground.
She has turned back into the small, quiet doll, perhaps exhausted from the action she just performed.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: You know that this geist was formed by the last speck of Jie's life force.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Wang drew you into the game and had you retrieve this object so that you could deliver it here and allow it to recuperate, in preparation for her return.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: But... consider it a burst of sentimentality from a reunion with someone long thought lost.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Please deliver it to the Tomb of Sui. The future is yet unsettled. Our family will gather outside the tomb.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I do not know if the day will come when Jie returns. But if Wang sees it as Jie's foundation, she should be there for this meeting.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Wang is in the tomb, and I must help him. There will be a battle. Carrying this object would be unsafe, and perhaps cause a delay...

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Leave it to me!
The Shanhaizhong snatches the token from the woman's hands before the Candleholder can react.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: I will see it done, in the name of Zushi!
The dignified woman bows deeply to the two youngsters.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lady Jun...

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: You blocked the attack against me at the gate, and protected Jie's legacy.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Has chivalry become a habit of yours?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I do what I do for the sake of justice.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: What is justice?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Justice is making sure that Wei Yenwu does not die an unjust death, and giving the old case a proper trial.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Justice is bringing closure to all that has happened between mother and father, between the imperial family and the House of Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Justice is making sure that the proxy who did so much for Great Yan did not die in vain, and giving Great Yan a chance at peace.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: What about justice for you as an Infected?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have seen so much suffering in my journeys... this land has been too kind to me. I wield my justice for the sake of others.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I can't help you with the justice you seek. But perhaps her relic can.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you mean... the writing knife?!

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Take it.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: The justice you seek is closely linked to the incident forty years ago.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: You are the only one to whom I can entrust this knife, who can right the wrongs for your family, for your country.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: There should be closure to the matters of the Ch'en family, Lord Wei's decision, and the thousand years of records for the land on which she once lived and breathed.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: These were the hopes that she placed upon the writing knife.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: The history of Great Yan should be written by the Yanese people.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Come with me.
They walk into the room.
Like revisiting a scene from an old play, Jun slowly walks through the room that has not changed one bit in the past century.
Everything is familiar. No one has touched it for a hundred years.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: It's been a while.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: The writing knife has resurfaced, but it is no longer in your hands. If I have entrusted it to the wrong person...

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I will shoulder the responsibility for any consequences on your behalf.
Ch'en's palm closes around the knife. Her fingertip trembles, as if the weight of a thousand books is upon her heart.
She has given her all wholeheartedly, and sacrificed herself selflessly. Now, everything has come together as appointed.
She clutches the writing knife. In her eyes, something sinks, and something else burns bright.
—It is the weight of an era, and a reunion that the knife has long awaited.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I hope... you will not disappoint.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I will not disappoint.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What's going on?!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: These geists just appeared out of nowhere!

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: The annals of Mangshan Town record that similar scenes of rampaging geists were spotted during the turmoil caused by Sui a hundred and twenty years ago.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Is the bestial Sui awakening?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: What a headache... guess it's happened after all.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Number Two, you fool, why are you dilly-dallying? How many times do I have to bail you out?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Lin Qingyan!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What are your instructions?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: This is where the geists are most rampant. They must not be allowed to enter Baizao!

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You and I will guard this pass. Do not let a single geist through!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Yes, master!

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: I can't hear you, girl!

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Look lively! Treat this as your entrance exam. Pass the test, and I'll take you as my student. Then you can make your old teacher call you 'master'!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I wouldn't dare!

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Is there anything that I can help with?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Help? What could you do...

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Watch my moves and record them. Then you can show them to your teacher and see who's better.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: The fire rises—

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Wait... *pant* wait for me... *pant*

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: You run too fast!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What's the matter? You were the one who was in a hurry.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If you're out of breath, give it to me and I'll deliver it.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: In your dreams!

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: You blockhead! Did you think about how we're supposed to enter the Tomb of Sui when we arrive?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: We'll explain to the soldiers guarding the tomb and ask them to let us through...

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Riiiiggghhht. And how do you plan to explain where you got the thing you're holding?

spans.text: And how do you plan to explain where you got the thing you're holding?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Or... maybe find a way to sneak in...

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Your brain really is made entirely of wood, isn't it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Do you have an idea, then?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: If we can't get inside the Tomb of Sui, we'll find someone who can.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Do you mean...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Who's there—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Show yourself!
Zuo Le senses a hostile presence and instinctively draws his sword.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: The thing you promised me.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Hand it over.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The Forbidden City is just ahead...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It should be heavily guarded, if the Grand Commandant really intends to sacrifice Wei Yenwu's life.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There are guards stationed at all the important intersections in the city. It should not be hard to detect unusual movements by a large force.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wait, is that...
Ch'en stops in her tracks.
She sees a figure.
A very familiar one.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You should not have come.
